# DnB Santa

> Free personalised voice-message maker. Father Christmas who grew up on drum & bass, jungle and rave music writes a short spoken script and records it as audio, in 30+ languages. Three themes: Christmas, Rave, GlowGadgets.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dnbsanta.com/): Fill in a name, age, occasion, wish/message and language — get a personalised spoken message back. One occasion, "Good Deed Celebration", celebrates someone's kind act instead of a wish. Free, no sign-in required.

## About

Part of the FeelFamous ecosystem — free AI tools for specialists, collectors, and personal sellers.
Built by Chris P Taylor (Doc Strange). PLUR. World domination through kindness. One ember at a time.
